style.styleTitle: Homcom 5ft Pre-Lit Christmas Tree with 150 LED Lights
style.toneOfVoice: Tangled lights and tricky setup can take the joy out of holiday decorating. The HOMCOM pre-lit Christmas tree brings instant festive charm to your home. Decorated with elegant golden ornaments, ribbons, and 150 warm white LEDs, it creates a full, glowing display. Choose from 8 lighting modes with the included remote, while hinged branches make setup quick and effortless—leaving more time to enjoy the magic of the season. . 450 lush PVC branch tips create a classic full silhouette for indoor holiday displays; . Pre-decorated with golden balls, ribbons, and bows for an elegant holiday display; . Pre-lit with 150 warm white LEDs, featuring 8 lighting modes controlled by the included remote; . Pre-attached hinged system allows tips to drop open automatically; . PVC foliage and metal frame with a foldable metal stand ensure reliable stability; . Two-section trunk enables easy setup and compact off-season storage; . Colour: Green; . Light Colour: Warm White; . Material: PVC, Metal; . Overall Dimensions: F90 x 150H cm; . Base Dimensions: F40 x 15H cm; . Tip Count: 450; . Light Count: 150; . Remote Control: 5m Range (CR2032 Battery Not Included); . Item Label: 83C-356V70GN; . Shaping Note: Approx. 30–45 minutes of manual tip shaping recommended to achieve maximum natural fullness.
